newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EP criticises structural funds policy.
newsitem.headline: EP criticises structural funds policy.

text.p: The European Parliament on Thursday launched a stinging attack on the European Union's Structural Funds, which account for nearly a third of the EU's budget.
The Structural Funds are fiendishly complicated to use, not properly targeted or coordinated and are seriously underspent, MEPs said in a report drafted by British Liberal Robin Teverson.
Teverson's report came in response to the European Commission's annual report on the use of the funds in 1994 - COM(95)583.

MEPs welcomed the substantial amount - 141 million Ecus - allocated to the fund for the period 1994-1999 but expressed concern about the Commission's failure to keep tabs on the money after it had been sent to the member states' goverments.
The parliament also approved three reports on the use of the Structural Funds in Greece, Portugal and Spain.
